name: HWR_SOC_MED_RL_RAW_SCR_B

columns.name: GBL_PRFL_ID
columns.description: This stores the Global Profile Id of the consumer.

columns.name: ROLE_ID_URI
columns.description: This stores the Role Id of the consumer

columns.name: ACCURACY
columns.description: This stores the information about the Accuracy of the Score

columns.name: IMPORTANCE
columns.description: This stores the information on the importance of the Raw Score

columns.name: PRECISION
columns.description: This stores the information on the precision of the score

columns.name: RELEVANCE
columns.description: This stores the relevance of the score.

columns.name: SCORE_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: This stores information about the timestamp when the score is created

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
